import json,copy,sys,shutil
from pathlib import Path
r,old,w=map(Path,sys.argv[1:4]);sys.path.insert(0,str(w/'tools/nr-color'));import hmd_assess as h,hmd_capture as c
p=lambda name:json.loads(h.read_json(r/(name+'.json'))['content'][0]['text'])
m=h.read_json(Path(p('scout4Get')['result']['manifest']['finalPath']));a=m['children'][0]['actual']['acquisition'];scene=p('frozen-scene');config=p('prepared-nr')['neuralRendering']['requestedConfiguration']
fid=r.name+'-character-fov095'
defs=[('face','skin','Visible face including eyes; blinking assessed separately',[1300,780,105,118],[780,780,105,118]),('forehead','skin','Forehead skin away from blinking eyelids',[1319,794,32,29],[810,794,32,29]),('armour','material','Engraved torso armour',[1130,990,160,160],[590,990,160,160]),('ground_shadow','shadow','Dark stone floor',[1740,1180,140,160],[1200,1180,140,160]),('ground','background','Textured stone floor outside the character',[1800,1550,160,180],[1260,1550,160,180])]
regions={'schemaVersion':1,'sceneFingerprint':fid,'motionGradientMismatchLimit':0.15,'eyes':{eye:{'nativeSize':[2468,2740],'regions':[{'id':d[0],'class':d[1],'description':d[2],'rect':d[3+n]} for d in defs],'unavailable':{'highlight':'No strong isolated highlight/clipping patch in this view.'}} for n,eye in enumerate(h.EYES)}}
cam={key:a['cameraEvidence'][key] for key in ['view','projection','positionAdjust']};cam.update(viewTolerance=.001,projectionTolerance=.000001,positionAdjustTolerance=.2)
spec=h.read_json(old/'spec.json');fixed=copy.deepcopy(config['upscaling']);fixed.pop('neuralRenderingEnabled')
spec.update(sceneFingerprint=fid,fixedSettings=fixed,fixedScene={'cameraEvidence':cam,'recordingScene':{'cell':scene['cell']['editorId'],'cellFormID':int(scene['cell']['formId'],16),'interior':True,'weatherFormID':int(scene['weather']['formId'],16)},'gameHour':scene['gameHour'],'gameHourTolerance':.01,'timeScale':0,'originalTimeScale':20,'trackingPolicy':'Physical tracking and actor AI unchanged; strict drift diagnostics retained, usefulness judged per region.'})
plan=h.make_plan(spec,regions,19419);c.validate_plan(plan);c.validate_fixed_scene(plan['fixedScene'])
selected=[1,2,3,5,6,8,9,11,12,14,16,17,19,20,22,23,25]
scope={'kind':'user_authorized_exploratory_comparison','selectedOrdinals':selected,'strictThresholdAdvisory':True,'policy':'Retain strict baseline, camera and gradient diagnostics without automatic rejection. Attribute effects only when repeated, visible and beyond observed baseline variation. Preserve unsafe or ambiguous comparisons as inconclusive; never normalize or align images.','why':'User requested useful comparison and explicitly overrode protocol-only stopping.','coverage':'Three unchanged baselines, each shown/hidden mode twice in forward/reverse order, two flanking baselines; remaining canonical repetitions not run.'}
for name,obj in [('regions',regions),('spec',spec),('private-plan',plan),('comparison-scope',scope)]:h.save_json(r/(name+'.json'),obj)
settings={key:c.candidate_colour(c.colour_editable(config['color']),value) for key,value in plan['candidateMapping'].items()}
data={'plan':plan,'schedule':plan['schedule'],'candidateConfigurations':settings,'selectedOrdinals':selected};h.save_json(r/'plan-data.json',data)
i=h.read_json(old/'campaign-index.json');i.update(planPath=str(r/'private-plan.json'),planSha256=h.digest(r/'private-plan.json'),sceneFingerprint=fid,fixedSettings=fixed,producer=m['producer'],sessionId=m['sessionId'],userSessionAuthorization=h.read_json(r/'user-session-authorization.json'),sequences=[],complete=False,comparisonScope=scope)
for k in ['terminalReason','baselineRepeatabilityQualified']:i.pop(k,None)
h.save_json(r/'campaign-index.json',i)
shutil.copy2(old/'direct-offline.py',r/'direct-offline.py')
print(json.dumps({'planSha256':i['planSha256'],'selected':selected,'conditions':[plan['candidateMapping'][plan['schedule'][n-1]['candidateId']]['condition'] for n in selected]}))
